newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 27.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Working committees set up by Ivory Coast's universities to return calm to campuses say students are not entitled in law to three months back grants they claim - Ivorian traders union SYNACCI seeks five billion CFA support fund for the sector from the government - Illegal timber felling in classified Ivorian forests remains a major problem officials tell workshop on the industry LA VOIE - Ivorian Privatisation Committee says attempt to sell of Vridi central garage as part of division and privatisation of Palmindustrie agro-industrial giant failed due to lack of offers LE JOUR - Body of Ernest Boka, first head of Ivory Coast's supreme court, exhumed for transfer to new mausoleum following his rehabilitation by President Henri Konan Bedie; Boka died in his thirties in 1964 in jail, reportedly committing suicide, after detention in connection with alleged plots against then government
